name: d121_3order_probe
notes: PROBE_SUM_AT_APERTURE_2026_08_11 arm B, re-run through the staged pipeline. Consumes the probe's ARCHIVED arm-A artifacts byte for byte (decompose='sumap_cache' + chain='cached_aperture'), so nothing upstream of the seam can differ and the S1.2 hazard -- a library edit moving a chain's absolute phase -- cannot contaminate the comparison. chain.ray_subsample=4 and n_fine_cap=8192 are what the ARCHIVE was produced with, not this pipeline's rs=1 default; they are stated so the artifact key is honest. Common grid dx_c=1.2292 um / N_c=8192 is the probe's configuration of record (S3, pitch-converged in S8.1). Score the intensity columns; the piston columns are pre-FIX_TILT_QUADRATIC_OPL.
